altText: AI-generated fictional fashion editorial of four adult women leaning together on a shaded stone terrace above a desert settlement. Their outfits include a red cutout mini, a white one-shoulder mini, a green-and-red crescent-and-star dress, and an emerald patterned two-piece. Rainbow legwear and varied red, rainbow, dark and metallic-green footwear accent the group. Distant fires, smoke columns and a mushroom-shaped cloud are invented dramatic scenery, not a record of a real event.
